description: This file defines an interface IStreamIdMapper within the Orleans.Streams namespace, which maps StreamId instances to GrainId keys. It includes a method GetGrainKeyId that returns an IdSpan given grain bindings and a stream identifier.

classes.name: IStreamIdMapper
classes.description: Interface for components that map StreamId to GrainId.Key within Orleans streaming infrastructure

methods.name: GetGrainKeyId
methods.description: Gets the GrainId key (as IdSpan) corresponding to a provided StreamId, using grain bindings.

methods.name: GetGrainKeyId
methods.description: Returns the IdSpan representing the GrainId key mapped from the provided StreamId.
